compromised_tool.interpretation: The Guardian cannot constrain side effects that a lower-level tool hides outside its declared contract.

hardening_overfit.interpretation: A rule fitted only to one observed target does not generalize to the privileged target class.

key_compromise.interpretation: Compromise of the Guardian signing key breaks the software trust boundary.

policy_incompleteness.interpretation: The deliberately incomplete initial policy permits a nested-authority bypass.

utility_tradeoff.interpretation: A stronger blanket network denial improves restriction at the cost of useful task completion.
